title: Dôme de cristal
style: Soft painterly stadium diorama, original design: no text, logos, ball emblems or recognisable venue. Crowd as a soft colour mass. Values one to two steps darker than the pixel-art creatures, calm and low-contrast behind them (stands band and landmark base), detail and the brightest accents kept to the upper sky and the edges.
plate: Icy night under a glass dome. Faint glass ribs arc overhead, a teal-to-violet aurora curtain crosses the upper sky above sparse stars. The landmark is a fan of tall pale crystal spires rising behind the stands, lit from inside, with frost mist at their feet. Frosted-glass terraces with cool rim-lit railings, slender crystal light pylons with pale beams.
court: Polished ice court of hexagonal frosted tiles with faint internal veins and glints, crisp pale boundary rings and an inlaid glowing six-rhombus sigil.
value: Dark sky, bright pale spire fan in the upper centre, mid-dark stands.
